MemeDef.label: Dark elf primacy
MemeDef.description: A dark elf's greatest aspiration is to serve the merciless Goddess of Darkness, in any of her advocations.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_DrowPrimacy)->[deity0_name] guided her people through the endless darkness of the deep places of the world.

episode(uses=1, tag=meme_DrowPrimacy)->[deity0_name] sipped satisfied from her goblet of blood when She saw the women led the way in the darkness. She bid her daughters to command and organize her workship, ripping and tearing all in their path, until the universe is bathed in blood.
intro(tag=meme_DrowPrimacy)->The daughters of [deity0_name] swept across the world, purging those unworthy to share the air that they breathed.
conflict(tag=meme_DrowPrimacy)->Every surface race stood in their path, wherever they went. By sword, spear or gun, they resisted the daughters of [deity0_name] with all their might.
victory(tag=meme_DrowPrimacy)->Yet the bloody blessings of their merciless goddess kept them surging onwards, overcoming adversity through sheer will and uncontrollable fury.
